title: Silent Night · Piano nỉ
heard: Jingle Bells done: "hãy sang bài tiếp theo" (go on to the next song)
about: v1: Jingle Bells' Piano nỉ 12a, the version the user chose, on Silent Night: the felt piano (its room, breath and player, its tone, the treble's knock mended), the quick ending; its strings and horns written anew for this carol by Composer's Assistant 2 hearing this piano (ai/strings.plan.json, take 2 of 3: every part off the chord 0.1-0.2 % of its time, none over the tune, its violas and horns the calmest), laid in as 12a's were: violas and cellos from the first verse's second half, violins in the last verse, horns in its second half, fitted to the chords, ending with the tune, in the far hall.
